market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile and range-bound. RBA rate decision is the dominant catalyst. Banks and gold support the index while iron ore weakness and oil-shock jitters cap upside. Qantas strike adds idiosyncratic risk. Expect ^AORD to trade in a tight band with sector rotation into defensives.
market_outlook.long_term: Rising 2027 recession odds and IMF fiscal warnings suggest a cautious 6–12 month backdrop. Structural positives in gold, AI infrastructure, and energy transition offset cyclical mining weakness. Housing affordability and immigration policy remain wildcards. Buffett's departure from Berkshire may trigger global capital reallocation flows.
